name: Turn The Tide
summary: Simultaneous-bid trick game where high weather cards force you to take tide cards and lose life preservers.
rules_text: Players receive 12 unique Weather cards numbered 1-60. Each Weather card may show 0, 0.5 or 1 life preserver icon; players take that many tokens, rounding down. Shuffle 24 Tide Level cards face down. A game has as many rounds as players. A round has 12 hands: reveal two Tide cards. All remaining players simultaneously play one Weather card face up. The highest Weather takes the lower Tide card and places it face up on its own pile covering previous tide. The second highest takes the other Tide card. Then the player(s) showing the highest Tide Level among all players must flip one life preserver face down. A player whose last preserver is flipped gets one extra life; eliminated on next loss. Round ends after 12 hands or when only two players remain. Score: 1 per face-up preserver, -1 if eliminated, plus 1 bonus for lowest Tide showing. Hands and deck pass left each round.
rating_reason: Bidding for cards to avoid highest tide, turn-based, strategic survival
